parameter_selection: Only E_mean and P10: seven-room LeaveOneGroupOut, six fitting rooms per fold, minimum unweighted room MAE in original units; ties follow candidate order. This is development parameter selection, not independent evaluation. HistGB settings remain frozen from v1.
refit: After parameter freeze, fit six estimators for five outputs on all 122640 TRAIN rows. P10 uses its own RF mean_log/ratio pair.
scope: Offline research trial, no additional simulations, no TEST fit/prediction/scoring, no automatic angle recommendation or control. Historical CV is not a test score for the full-seven-room package.
